name: app-factory
description: End-to-end project orchestrator: from an idea, an app to clone and personalize, or an existing app to finish, to the finished product in production. 18 subagents (product, project management, architecture, data, design, security, compliance, finops, dev, review, QA, release, SRE, growth, verifier), phases and validation gates, state on disk and resume, autopilot mode (scheduled wakeups, only vision decisions raised as GitHub issues).
